'''Mooga''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mooga system/Legends|Mooga system]] of the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]]. It was the homeworld of the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
[[File:Moogans-Corruption.png|thumb|left|150px|150px|Members of the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] species.]]
The Moogans originated on the planet Mooga, in the [[Mooga system/Legends|Mooga system]] of the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]], located along the northeastern border of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], their planet fell under the control of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and became integrated into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="Corruption" /> [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] officials from the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], which had its supply lines cut due to its neutral stance against the war, began communications with the Moogans in order to [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|smuggle]] products to the surface and establish a [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref> Among the goods was the [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]], which was diluted with a [[Slabin/Legends|harmful chemical]] in order to increase their profits from the sale of the tea.<ref name="Corruption" /> The smuggling ring was identified and decimated by [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]], led by [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], before being linked to [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]].<ref name="Corruption" /><ref name="Academy" />
